portability_and_directory_aliases.scope: Final core code: real venv entries and dependencies across cwd/PATH changes, legacy fingerprints, noisy/invalid/failed probes, namespace source drift, declared source encodings, portable path components, and eight original installer contracts through real directory aliases. Twelve skips require native Windows.

initial_governance_integration.scope: Environment/execution/project/filesystem integration and five directory-alias contracts before the diagnostics CLI and three additional alias cases; not added to the full suite count.

complete_host_suite.scope: Complete suite on the actual host runtime with throwaway test HOME before final stream/receipt/CLI changes. Later changes have separate affected checks; platform CI executes the final committed source.

restricted_sandbox_attempt.scope: Three archive-copy owner preservation failures and six local HTTP/browser-listener failures under the execution sandbox. Same complete suite passed on the host; original failure XML, stderr and command outputs retained privately.

UTF8_probe_followup.scope: Final child stream encoding and Chinese stdout/stderr/CLI diagnostics, plus framed failures/timeouts, legacy/relative entries and namespace checks. One Windows suffix-omission case requires native CI.

pinned_receipt_followup.scope: All portability and existing environment-governance checks after binding four-layer processes to the probed interpreter. Metadata commands assert the actual executable and all receipts record its absolute entry; final newline-neutral diagnostics assertions have a separate follow-up.

Unicode_CI_diagnostics.scope: Actual Unicode failure annotation under PYTHONIOENCODING=ascii and the newline-neutral Chinese stdout/stderr import check. The earlier reporter UnicodeEncodeError reproduction is retained privately.

final_CLI_and_execution_followup.scope: Portability, Unicode CI annotation and existing actual execution checks after seven governance CLIs and the execution bootstrap emit UTF-8; case comparisons retain the logical interpreter entry. Three extra CLI fixtures were added afterward and checked separately.

all_seven_CLI_output_coverage.scope: Additional actual audit/doctor/state-root/code-map and artifact/execution error CLIs under ASCII output settings, including Chinese file paths and purpose text; the environment inspect CLI is covered by the preceding checks.

fingerprint_compatibility.legacy_relative_entry: Bound to the absolute validated executable without rewriting the fixed record; ambiguous entries require a new revision
fingerprint_compatibility.venv_executable_symlink: Preserved as a logical entry, never dereferenced to base Python
fingerprint_compatibility.diagnostics: Optional inspect --diagnostics retains captured import stdout/stderr and actual exit code
